summary: Both candidates fail. GLM preserves most prose but corrupts names, formulas, dates/page provenance and every crop; Haiku drops readable solutions and heavily corrupts statements. Corrected transcription checked against all three source pages, all ten candidate crops, and all seventeen checker findings; catalogue provenance remains explicitly escalated. Sonnet candidate adjudicated 2026-09-12 by agent:fable: fail (3 critical figure-crop defects — nicked label tops in p2-fig1, clipped orbit edge plus a swallowed half-line in p1-fig1, a swallowed half-line and column fragments in p3-fig1 — 1 major dropped Δλ_r index in the galaxy solution, 7 minor wording/notation/metadata deviations), yet its text is the closest read so far and exposed four gold errors (използувана→използвана, the silently normalised Δλ_2→Δλ_g, the Bulgarianised Frost epigraph, and a p2-fig1 box that excluded the printed galaxy image) which were corrected in the gold; the GLM checker's „pass“ with two accurate info findings is a false pass, since it certified verbatim text and unclipped crops that the pages contradict.
